paite: Persia kumpipa Kura kum khatna ah, Jeremiah kam a TOUPA thu hihtangtun ahihtheihna ding in, TOUPA'N Persia kumpipa Kura kha atokthou a, huchi in agamsung teng ah thupuan abawl a, agelhthoh in leng akoih hi.
heading: Kura In Judahte Kik Nawn Ding Thu Apia

paite: Hichibang in Persia kumpipa Kura in achi, “TOUPA, van Pathian in, Lei gam tengteng kei ahon peta hi; Judah a om Jerusalem a amah inn lamsak ding in kei thu ahon pia hi.
Amite tengteng na lak ua om peuhmah, akiang ah Pathian om henla, Judah a om Jerusalem ah hohtou henla, TOUPA Israel' Pathian, amah Pathian ahi, Jerusalem a om inn lam hen.

Kuapeuh akhualtamna koi mun peuh a nutsiat a omna mun a mite'n, amah dangka leh dangka-eng, vante leh gantate in panpih uhenla, Jerusalem a om Pathian inn a ding a ut thu a thillat chih louh," chi in.
Huchi in Judah leh Benjamin intekpate inkuan a lupente, siampute leh Levite, Pathian in Jerusalem a om TOUPA' inn lam dia hohtou dia akha uh atohthohte tengteng, athouta uhi.
Huan akimvel ua omte tengteng in akhut uh dangka tui-um belsuan dangka-engte, vante, gantate leh thil manphate in ahihhat ua, uttak a piakte tengteng sim louh in.
Kumpipa Kura in leng TOUPA' inn a tui-um belsuan Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem a kipan alakkhiak, pathiante inn a akoihte alakhe vek hi;
Huaite Persia kumpipa Kura in sumkempa Mithredath khut in alakhe vek a, Judah vaihawm, Sesbazzar pia in asimsak hi.
Huchi in hiai amuh zah uh ahi: dangka-eng kuang sawmthum, dangka kuang sangkhat, gimlim halna kuang sawmnih-le-kua;
Dangka-eng noubem sawmthum, dangka noubem ahoih lou deuhte zali-le-sawmkhat leh tui-um belsuan dangte sangkhat.
Dangka-eng leh dangka tui-um belsuan tengteng sangnga-le-zali ahi uh. Saltangte lak ate Babulon a kipan Jerusalem a pitouh a a-om lai un, hiai tengteng Sesbazzar in atawitou vek hi.
